## The Python path: Unsloth Core {#core}

When the GUI is not enough, the same engine is scriptable:

```python
from unsloth import FastLanguageModel
from trl import SFTTrainer
from datasets import load_dataset

model, tokenizer = FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained(
    model_name="unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-bnb-4bit",
    max_seq_length=2048,
    load_in_4bit=True,          # QLoRA
)
model = FastLanguageModel.get_peft_model(
    model, r=16,
    target_modules=["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj", "o_proj"],
)
trainer = SFTTrainer(
    model=model, tokenizer=tokenizer,
    train_dataset=load_dataset("json", data_files="internal_corpus.jsonl")["train"],
    max_seq_length=2048,
)
trainer.train()
model.save_pretrained_gguf("gguf/", tokenizer)
```

::: {.en}
CLI equivalents exist for automation: `unsloth train`, `unsloth inference`, `unsloth export`, `unsloth list-checkpoints`. Studio configs saved as YAML can be replayed headlessly — CI-friendly.
:::

::: {.fr}
Des équivalents CLI existent pour l'automatisation : `unsloth train`, `unsloth inference`, `unsloth export`, `unsloth list-checkpoints`. Les configs YAML du Studio se rejouent sans interface — compatible CI.
